# NFL Daily — 2026-11-02 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson will have thumb surgery and go on injured reserve — out at least four games — after reinjuring it on the first snap of his return in Sunday's 36-10 loss to Buffalo. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-thumb-injured-ravens-bills-2026)
- Titans DT Jeffery Simmons was traded to the Bears, one of the first blockbuster deals ahead of the Nov. 10 trade deadline. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50043471/2026-trade-deadline-updates-latest-news-deals-terms)
- Lions LB Jack Campbell remains hospitalized for evaluation of a neck injury, though the team says early signs are positive. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50360680/lions-lb-jack-campbell-hospital-signs-positive)
- Jaguars DT DaVon Hamilton is expected to miss the rest of the season with a torn quad. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50358564/sources-jaguars-dt-hamilton-torn-quad-likely-season)
- Packers DE Micah Parsons is set to practice this week for the first time since tearing his ACL and meniscus last December. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50360850/packers-expect-parsons-practice-some-week)
- 49ers WR Brandon Aiyuk has hired Drew Rosenhaus, who says he's working to get Aiyuk back on an NFL roster. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50360681/brandon-aiyuk-hires-drew-rosenhaus-agent-eyes-return-nfl)
- Packers coach Matt LaFleur said the team is keeping RB Josh Jacobs on the roster despite new abuse allegations against him. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50360755/packers-sticking-rb-jacobs-latest-abuse-allegations)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-02 (Past 1 day(s))

## Key news
- QB Lamar Jackson will undergo thumb surgery and go on injured reserve — out a minimum of four games — after his comeback lasted just one offensive play in Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-thumb-injured-ravens-bills-2026)
- Backup QB Tyler Huntley is also dealing with a possible turf toe injury suffered on a QB hit in the same game. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/joe-fagnano-tyler-huntley-injured-toe-questionable-emergency-quarterback)
- Third-string QB Joe Fagnano took over and was sacked three times in 25 drop-backs; he left with a knee issue but says he hopes to play Thursday against the Jaguars. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/joe-fagnano-tyler-huntley-injured-toe-questionable-emergency-quarterback)
- The Ravens signed QB Austin Reed in response to the QB room's injuries. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-sign-quarterback-austin-reed-lamar-jackson-tyler-huntley)

# Rivals — 2026-11-02 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Steelers reclaimed first place in the AFC North, beating the Browns 27-6 for their fourth straight win. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7744427/2026/11/01/browns-steelers-nfl-week-8-score-result-takeaways/)

- Bills S C.J. Gardner-Johnson was placed on the reserve/suspended list. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Bengals edge Cashius Howell had wrist surgery and is trending toward injured reserve, expected out "weeks." [Paul Dehner Jr.](https://x.com/pauldehnerjr/status/2117315882930295177)
